name: k08-startup-latency
title: K08 startup latency: lazy entry/cli imports, lazy LLM client, bench script
description: Reduce cold-start cost: make entry.py heavy imports lazy (chat/functions/provider/role), move cli.py prompt_toolkit/rich imports to their use sites, defer LLM client construction until first request (REPL first prompt ~1.55s -> ~0.62s), add scripts/bench.py measuring --version/--help/--template/one-shot and a regression gate. No behavior change.
